description: For every natural number \(a\) and list \(s\), \(C(a::s)=K(a,C(s))\), where \(K(a,c)=1+p(a,c)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code_cons (a : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code (a :: s) =
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.cons a
      (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code s)
